description: This file defines the AgentsController class in an ASP.NET Core Web API project. It provides REST API endpoints for managing 'Agent' entities, including retrieving multiple agents, getting a single agent by ID, pinging an agent, and bootstrapping an agent with updated details.

classes.name: AgentsController
classes.description: REST API controller for managing Agent entities, with endpoints for retrieving, updating ping time, and bootstrapping agents.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of all agents, ordered by the last ping time descending.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific agent by ID.

methods.name: PatchAgent
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update the 'last ping' timestamp of an agent.

methods.name: BootAgent
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to bootstrap or update agent details, including version, hostname, architecture, and other system info.

search-terms: agent entity managed via Entity Framework
